payload.purpose_context: The PR #171 landing left three follow-ups. The draft gates guess envDir/envFile by searching config text, so a setting in an imported base config is missed and the gate silently reads the wrong .env file (#173). The _links dead-link check only accepts an index at api/index.json, so a site using a custom indexPath cannot pass it (#172). sitemapDraftFilter still sits in config.ts instead of its integration module (#174).
payload.purpose_tldr: Make DocKitty's build gates read the site's real Astro config and agent-API index path, and finish the config.ts split.

payload.question: When a config exists but fails to evaluate, what do the draft gates do?

payload.final_answer: Fail closed with exit 2 (check-links parity); --env-dir <dir|false> is the explicit override that skips evaluation.

payload.question: How does the artifact gate learn a custom agent-API index path?

payload.final_answer: An --index-path flag only; default stays api/index.json; no discovery from built output.

payload.question: Support envDir set inside an integration updateConfig hook?

payload.final_answer: No: keep it as the one documented limit in ADR-0058.
